question: Who among the following was the top run-scorer for India at the 1983 Cricket World Cup final with 38 runs?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Krishnamachari Srikkanth**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Krishnamachari Srikkanth:**

 
 
• Krishnamachari Srikkanth was the highest run-scorer for India in the 1983 World Cup final, scoring 38 runs.
 
• He played an aggressive opening innings, providing a crucial start for India against a formidable West Indies bowling attack.
 
• His innings included 7 fours and 1 six.
 
• He played a very important role in setting the tone for India's batting.
 
• His aggressive style of batting was a key part of his play.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kapil Dev:**

 
 
• Kapil Dev, the captain of the Indian team, played a crucial role in the victory, but his contribution in the final was more significant with his captaincy and fielding than his batting.
 
• He scored 15 runs in the final.
 
• His famous catch of Viv Richards was a turning point in the match.
 
• He led the team with great determination and inspired them to victory.
 
• His contribution to the 1983 world cup tournament was immense.
 
 
 
• **Mohinder Amarnath:**
 
 
• Mohinder Amarnath was named the Man of the Match in the final for his all-round performance.
 
• He scored 26 runs and took 3 wickets.
 
• He played a steady innings, contributing to India's total.
 
• His bowling was very effective, and he took key wickets.
 
• He was known for his calm and composed demeanor under pressure.
 
 
 
• **Sandeep Patil:**
 
 
• Sandeep Patil played a brief innings in the final.
 
• He scored 27 runs.
 
• He attempted to accelerate the scoring rate.
 
• He was known for his aggressive batting style.
 
• He played a supporting role in the middle order.
